fact: For the 2019-2020 school year pupils of nursery, primary and secondary schools were told to identify themselves online on SMART ECOLE, a school-management platform built for the ministry by its DTSI with technical partners (the page is signed EDIATTAH Conseils & Solutions) and administered by the DELC, covering online enrolment through to the proclamation of results.
title: SMART ECOLE
publisher: SMART ECOLE by EDIATTAH Conseils & Solutions
